entries.alt: Four fictional adult women share a back hug and linked hands on a stone terrace above Monrovia's Atlantic waterfront. Short Liberia flag, cobalt and ivory looks pair with rainbow ankle boots, white platforms, rainbow pumps and silver stilettos.

Four fictional adult women share a clothed lap rest, shoulder touch and open-handed exchange at a forested Robertsport coastal overlook. Short bronze, white, cobalt and Liberia flag looks pair with rainbow knee-highs, platforms, silver pumps, rainbow stilettos and white boots.

Four fictional adult women lean into a close side hug at Kpatawee Waterfall, smiling across an overlapping diagonal. Burgundy and Liberia flag fashion fills the tight portrait, with a star tattoo visible on Alia's shoulder.

Four fictional adult women exchange linked hands and side hugs on a rainforest terrace in Sapo National Park. Short dark red, Liberia flag and ivory looks include white and red boots, rainbow RAZE knee-highs, green platforms and visible agency and RAZE tattoos.
